about: Daily Slack DM: for each person, today's tweets and topics worth engaging with. Edit freely; the next run uses it.
company: Rox (rox.com): an AI-native revenue platform. Agents research accounts, find prospects, and draft outreach for sellers, on top of a CRM-replacing system of record. ~170 people, SF and Bangalore, valued at $1.2B in March 2026. Competes with Salesforce, HubSpot, Clay, Gong, Apollo, Outreach, and Attio.
guidance: Pick posts where this person can add something real (expertise, a data point, an experience), not just a like.
Prefer what's tactically dominating today: posts climbing fast from prominent accounts, or the topic everyone in their circle is reacting to.
Never pick politics, culture-war fights, layoffs-dunking, tragedies, or anything that could look bad for a Rox executive or employee.
Don't pick Rox's own posts or posts by these six people.
Competitor posts are fine when there's a smart, non-promotional take; never suggest dunking on competitors or customers.

people.name: Ishan
people.label: CEO
people.profile: Second-time founder; previously Chief Growth Officer at New Relic. Speaks for the company: the future of sales and CRM, AI agents doing real GTM work, enterprise AI adoption, company building, and the AI-native vs incumbent (Salesforce) fight. Senior voice: big-picture takes, not low-level technical debates.
engage_on: future of sales, CRM, and GTM
big raises, ARR milestones, and market moves in AI apps

people.name: Shriram
people.label: CTO
people.profile: Infrastructure veteran: led data infrastructure at Confluent (making Kafka faster and cheaper across clouds) and worked on Amazon Aurora. Credible on databases, distributed systems, data platforms, reliability and cost at scale, the infrastructure behind production agents, and building engineering orgs.
engage_on: agent infrastructure in production: cost, latency, evals

people.name: Gopal
people.role: Research lead at Rox (Rox Research, agents)
people.label: Research lead
people.profile: Highly technical: MIT math and physics, IMO and IPhO medalist, research background in probability and combinatorics. Leads agents research at Rox, which has started publishing its results. Engages on frontier research with rigor: papers, RL and post-training, reasoning, evals and benchmarks, agent architectures, AI for math.

people.name: Dan
people.role: At Rox since it acquired his company Quilt; ex-founder and ex-Sequoia partner
people.label: Ex-founder, ex-Sequoia
people.profile: Older and more experienced: two-time founder (Hero.app, acquired by People.ai in 2021; Quilt, AI assistants for technical sales and solutions teams, acquired by Rox in 2025) and a former Sequoia partner. Credible on venture and startup strategy, founder lessons, M&A, enterprise sales and presales, and how AI changes selling to enterprises.
engage_on: enterprise sales, solutions engineering, and presales

people.name: Taeuk
people.label: Founding engineer
people.profile: Younger engineer, Stanford CS. Built LLM agents and RAG at X and data pipelines at Stripe; at Rox built the workflow builder and the inbound lead agent. Engages as a builder: shipping agents in production, coding agents and dev tools, retrieval, voice agents, and SF builder culture.
engage_on: coding agents and dev tools (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor)

people.name: Brian
people.label: Engineer
people.profile: Younger engineer, Stanford. Works on Rox's agents with Gopal, rearchitecting how the agent pulls the right signals out of customer and market data. Engages as a builder: agent engineering and signal extraction, retrieval and data pipelines for agents, AI coding tools and workflows, new developer launches, and SF engineering culture.
engage_on: retrieval and data pipelines for agents
new developer launches people are trying
